o_work_monitor_recovery.reason: The platform shows an invocation after O_OPERATIONS config 8 and authoritative O main shows same-owner generation-22 progress after that invocation, but note has no config-8 o_work_monitor_recovery receipt as of the frozen observation.

optimization_decision.reason: Behavioral progress under generation 22 is visible in authoritative O, but the first observed post-config-8 physical invocation has no durable note receipt. Config 9 adds a mandatory durable-exit receipt barrier and a receipt-gap reconstruction rule without granting new O write authority or treating receipt absence as stop evidence.

before_after.before: Config 8 required durable observations in general but did not mechanically make receipt persistence an exit barrier. A physical monitor invocation could make authoritative O progress and still leave no role receipt, weakening executed-versus-configured observability.
before_after.after: Config 9 requires an invocation-bound immutable receipt before controllable exit/no-change completion; failure is classified durable_receipt_failed, and the next invocation must persist a gap diagnostic before recovery mutation. Missing receipt never authorizes stop/recovery/duplicate launch.

rollback.rollback_condition: Rollback only if the receipt barrier itself prevents safe O liveness/recovery work after the role has enough note-write capability, causes O mutation solely for observability, or incorrectly treats a live prior invocation as stopped. Preserve single-writer/fence/CAS, inbox preflight, payload-bound holds and no-duplicate-launch semantics on rollback.
rollback.rollback_scope: O_OPERATIONS only; do not roll back DOWNSTREAM_STATE or CLEAN controls.

termination.reason: A material O monitor observability repair was applied; C18 and O generation-22 continuation remain active frontiers.

exact_next_action: Verify the next o_work_monitor_recovery invocation resolves O_OPERATIONS config 9 and emits a config-9 immutable receipt even for no-change or blocker outcomes.

If no config-9 receipt appears, require a receipt-gap diagnostic first and determine whether the failure is note-write capability, premature termination, or uncontrolled long-running invocation; do not infer O stop or launch a duplicate from receipt absence.
Verify generation 22 remains single-writer/fenced and that any next mutation is based on current O liveness/inbox state rather than platform last_run_time.
Inspect the first exact-C18 novelty/relevance and evidence outputs and require persisted canonical-key/digest validation before integration; no config change is currently indicated.
Keep O human-request monitor unchanged unless the authoritative queue object changes; keep physical scheduler settings unchanged.
